newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algerian province's oldest voter, 110, casts vote.
newsitem.headline: Algerian province's oldest voter, 110, casts vote.

text.p: The oldest voter in Algeria's mountainous Batna province, 110-year-old Hadda Yahiaoui, voted on Thursday in the country's general election.
The official news agency APS said Mrs Yahiaoui cast her vote in Seffiane district, 70 km (45 miles) west of the provincial capital, Batna.
Numerous children and grandchildren accompanied her to vote, the agency said. It did not reveal which party she favoured, but said that several candidates had sought her vote.
